title: Cybernetic and Epistemic: A Missing Vocabulary for Trustworthy Agentic Delegation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00961v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As code generation is increasingly delegated to AI systems, the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to supervising the systems that write it --- a shift CS-education researchers have begun to name. This shift exposes a vocabulary gap: the field asks for "human oversight" without a working distinction between the two things language does in a delegation channel --- coordinate action (cybernetic: words succeed when the world comes to match them) and coordinate understanding (epistemic: they succeed when they answer to the world and a hearer can check that they do). The failure this names is not cybernetic language but epistemic-form language doing cybernetic work: explanation-shaped output calibrated for approval rather than truth. Oversight that checks only whether an output was approved is satisfiable by rubber-stamping; oversight that holds an agent accountable requires the reasoning behind its work be retrievable and checkable. translated_title: 控制论式与认知式：可信智能体委托中缺失的一套词汇
translated_abstract: 随着代码生成越来越多地被委托给AI系统，瓶颈正从编写代码转向监督那些编写代码的系统——计算机科学教育研究者已经开始为这一转变命名。这一转变暴露出一个词汇缺口：该领域在呼吁“人类监督”时，并未对语言在委托通道中所起的两种作用做出有效区分——协调行动（控制论式：当世界变得与话语相符时，话语即成功）与协调理解（认知式：当话语如实回应世界、且听者能够核实这一点时，话语即成功）。本文所指出的失败并非控制论式语言，而是认知形式的语言在干控制论的活：即为获得批准而非追求真实而校准的、解释形态的输出。只检查输出是否被批准的监督，可以被“橡皮图章”式的走形式所满足；而要让智能体真正承担责任的监督，则要求其工作背后的推理过程是可检索、可核查的。
tldr: 本文提出区分语言在AI智能体委托中的两种作用——协调行动的“控制论式”语言与协调理解的“认知式”语言，指出监督失效的根源在于用解释形式的语言去干控制论的活（输出为获批准而非真实而校准），并主张可信的人类监督要求智能体推理过程可检索、可核查。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a missing vocabulary distinguishing cybernetic language (coordinating action) from epistemic language (coordinating understanding) in agentic delegation, arguing that oversight failures stem from epistemic-form language doing cybernetic work—outputs calibrated for approval rather than truth—and that trustworthy human oversight requires an agent's reasoning to be retrievable and checkable.
